title: SVE author 1.0 shared leaf and reference definitions
$comment: Leaf, reference-atom, target-role, numeric, receipt, object-query and recipient fragment library. Object selectors include object unions and exclude leaders; RecipientSel adds leaders and unions containing a leader limb. Count queries retain distinct counted roles. Operands and filters have partial domains, not full Expr/Cond/Sel. Snapshot reads grant no operation authority. The root rejects standalone documents; select a $defs entry. Full authored/expanded profiles are not implemented. Quantity positions share numeric-operation with signed expressions. Single-group Target, choose, search and counter costs are closed fragments; DeckSlice has only documented action-level top consumers. Full action parents, source-role and scope admission remain separate.
